b: Expanding the company’s line of electric guitars, Winzz Musical Instruments has introduced the WGT150, a modern interpretation of the iconic T-style guitar. The new model combines traditional tonal characteristics with upgraded materials, refined ergonomic features, and versatile hybrid electronics.

The WGT150 is constructed with a solid alder body topped with a flamed maple veneer and finished in a high-gloss coating. This tonewood pairing complements the classic silhouette by combining balanced resonant characteristics with an elevated visual presentation.

Designed for contemporary playability, the neck is crafted from roasted Canadian maple featuring a comfortable C+D profile and a smooth satin finish. It is paired with a rosewood fingerboard sporting a 10-inch (254 mm) radius and 22 stainless steel frets for extended durability and easy bending performance.

At the heart of the WGT150’s electronics is the proprietary Winzz Refined-T Set pickup configuration. The neck position houses a PAF-style humbucker loaded with an Alnico II magnet for warm, full-bodied output, while the bridge features a '52-style single-coil designed to deliver classic, bright T-style clarity and twang. Controlled via a standard 3-way switch and master volume and tone pots, the tone control includes a push/pull function for coil splitting, expanding the instrument's overall sonic versatility.

The hardware setup emphasizes performance stability and traditional feel. A vintage T-style bridge equipped with three brass saddles enhances dynamic response and sustain, while a 4+2 locking tuning machine layout provides fast string changes and reliable tuning integrity. The instrument comes factory-equipped with 0942 coated strings.
Alder body with flamed maple top, glossy finish
Roasted Canadian maple neck, C+D profile, satin finish
Rosewood fingerboard, 10” radius, with 22 stainless steel frets
Pickups: Refined-T Set ('52-style single-coil bridge + Alnico II PAF-style neck humbucker)
Controls: Master Volume, Master Tone (with push/pull coil split), 3-way switch
Vintage T-style bridge with 3 brass saddles, 4+2 locking tuners
The Winzz WGT150 is available for a street price of $565.99 USD. For more information, please visit www.winzzguitars.com.
